turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What's been frustrating about the support experience?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: We're on the free tier for testing and support response has been slow — four days for a ticket about a rate-limiting question. I understand paid tiers get priority, but four days stalled our evaluation.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Would that affect whether you upgrade?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It actually made us hesitant. If free-tier support is that slow, we worry paid-tier will be slow too if we hit a real production incident.
